stories.headline: SpaceX just bought Cursor, the AI coding editor
stories.blurb: The acquisition is now official. Cursor, one of the fastest-growing AI coding tools, is now part of SpaceX. No financial terms were disclosed, but the move signals SpaceX's push to bring AI tooling in-house as it scales Starship production and satellite operations.
stories.why_it_matters: A rocket company now owns one of the hottest dev tools in Silicon Valley.
stories.original_headline: SpaceX officially closes its Cursor acquisition

stories.headline: ChatGPT can now edit your Google Drive files without leaving the chat
stories.blurb: Paid ChatGPT users can now open, read, and edit Google Drive documents directly inside ChatGPT conversations. Files can be added to your ChatGPT Library and modified on the fly—no tab-switching required.
stories.why_it_matters: Your AI assistant just became your document editor too.
stories.original_headline: ChatGPT subscribers can now open and edit Google Drive files from inside the chat

stories.headline: Google lets you hide the AI sparkle on Gemini images and videos
stories.blurb: Google added a toggle to remove the visible watermark from AI-generated images, videos, and music in Gemini and its Flow video tool. The sparkle icon that appears in the bottom corner can now be turned off through a 'Media watermark' setting.
stories.why_it_matters: AI-generated content just got harder to spot at a glance.
stories.original_headline: You can now turn off Google Gemini’s visible watermarks

stories.headline: Microsoft is merging its consumer and work Copilot apps into one
stories.blurb: Microsoft is combining its separate consumer Copilot and Microsoft 365 Copilot apps into a single unified app that handles both personal and work accounts. The new app keeps the 'Microsoft Copilot' name but gets a refreshed icon, and Microsoft is calling it a step toward a 'super app' experience.
stories.why_it_matters: One less app to juggle if you use Copilot for both personal tasks and work.
stories.original_headline: Microsoft is combining its Copilot apps ahead of a ‘super app’

try_this_prompt.title: The negotiation flip
try_this_prompt.prompt: I'm about to negotiate something I'll describe below. Don't tell me what to ask for — I already know. Instead: write the opening line from their perspective that would make me say yes instantly, then explain what that reveals about leverage I'm not using.
try_this_prompt.tool_hint: When you've prepped your talking points but haven't thought like the other side.
